title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 7, part 1: Ulysses S. Grant
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 7, part 1" compiled by James D. Richardson is a historical collection copyrighted in 1897. This volume presents the official proclamations, messages, and speeches of President Ulysses S. Grant during his two terms from March 1869 to March 1877. Part of an eleven-volume series documenting American presidential communications from 1787 to 1902, it preserves the executive voice during the critical Reconstruction era.
